The '''Ja highlands''' were a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].<ref name="GatORW" /> The [[Bay of Conquest|Ja-Phelar Bay]] [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] was located between the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Phelar/Legends|Phelar]] and the Ja highlands.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II||Ja-Phelar Bay}}</ref> The highlands shared its name with [[Ja Knoll]].<ref name="GatORW" />
